citation: United Nations, DESA, Population Division (2024). World Population Prospects 2024, Online Edition.

evidence_files.description: Unaltered source fields/values for every selected country/year/age row; filtered rows only.

review_scope: technical source, unit, age and sex mapping; no epidemiological calibration

terms.source: UN WPP official downloads catalogue copyright/footer

transformations: Select countries/areas with ISO3 and years 2024,2025,2026,2027,2028,2029,2030 from the original WPP2024 Medium file.
Map published female/male/total columns to sex; retain both for checking only.
Multiply published thousands by 1000 exactly; preserve 100+ as an open age interval.
Retain WPP projection status from 2024; no interpolation, extrapolation or relabelling.
